apaItuLooptani.question: What is LoopTani?
apaItuLooptani.answer: LoopTani is Indonesia's AI-based Circular Agriculture Marketplace. LoopTani connects farmers, processing industries, and buyers to trade agricultural waste (rice husks, straw, palm fronds), processed organic products (compost, maggot/got, silage), and secondhand farming equipment.

kenapaLooptani.question: Why Use LoopTani?
kenapaLooptani.answer: LoopTani turns crop residues that are usually burned into new income streams. In addition, LoopTani is equipped with Loopi AI Assistant for farming consultation, precision Fertilizer Dosage Calculator, SNI-standard Waste Analyzer, and environmental emission impact certification (Jejak Lestari).

caraJadiSeller.question: How to Become a Seller on LoopTani?
caraJadiSeller.answer: It's very easy! Create a LoopTani account -> go to your profile -> select 'Register Store / Seller' -> fill in your store name and shipping location address. Once active, you can immediately upload your waste or agricultural product catalog to the marketplace.

apaItuLoopiAi.question: What is Loopi AI & How Does It Work?
apaItuLoopiAi.answer: Loopi AI is LoopTani's integrated artificial intelligence assistant. Loopi can analyze the feasibility of your waste processing, calculate precise nutrient fertilization dosages, and provide nearby product or seller recommendations.

limbahAnalyzerKalkulator.question: What is the Purpose of Waste Analyzer & Fertilizer Calculator?
limbahAnalyzerKalkulator.answer: Waste Analyzer provides straw/palm processing guidelines based on SNI standards along with projected selling prices. Fertilizer Dosage Calculator helps calculate precise amounts of NPK, Urea, and Organic fertilizer based on your land area.

keamananTransaksi.question: Are Transactions and Payments Safe on LoopTani?
keamananTransaksi.answer: Yes, 100% safe. All payments are processed automatically via verified Payment Gateway (Xendit) supporting Bank Virtual Accounts, QRIS, and E-Wallets with real-time transaction status updates.
